biocontainers.name: bioconductor-appreci8r
biocontainers.summary: appreci8R: an R/Bioconductor package for filtering SNVs and short indels with high sensitivity and high PPV

biotools.summary: The appreci8R is an R version of our appreci8-algorithm - A Pipeline for PREcise variant Calling Integrating 8 tools. Variant calling results of our standard appreci8-tools (GATK, Platypus, VarScan, FreeBayes, LoFreq, SNVer, samtools and VarDict), as well as up to 5 additional tools is combined, evaluated and filtered.
